name: Thule Ravenclaw
summary: At the Undercity, a courier brings Bethor Iceshard strange Rot Hide ichor. Bethor recognizes the work of Thule Ravenclaw, his traitorous former colleague, and prepares counter-incantations to help the Forsaken resist the gnolls.

sections.title: A Colleague Turned Traitor
sections.body: Bethor Iceshard studies the courier’s sample in the Undercity’s Magic Quarter and finds an arcane mark. Thule Ravenclaw made the distillation. Before the Third War, Thule was a bright young mage and Bethor’s colleague. When the Lich King rose to power, Thule betrayed his peers and swore himself to the Scourge. As Lordaeron fell, he abandoned his humanity.

sections.title: The Master of Fenris Isle
sections.body: Bethor learns that Thule survived the war and now holds Fenris Keep on Fenris Isle in Lake Lordamere. Thule commands the Rot Hide gnolls, filling them with foul magic and sending them against Forsaken borders. Drawing on his close knowledge of Thule’s magic, Bethor writes a scroll to counter the mage’s curses and wards.

sections.title: Alchemical Countermeasures
sections.body: A courier carries Bethor’s scroll to the Sepulcher for Apothecary Renferrel of the Royal Apothecary Society. Renferrel studies the Undercity mage’s potent incantations, then joins high sorcery with the Society’s alchemical brews. Made specifically to shatter Ravenclaw’s hexes, the mixture clears a path for an assault on Fenris Keep.

faq.answer: Before the Scourge claimed him, Thule Ravenclaw was a promising human mage trained in Dalaran who studied with Bethor Iceshard. He betrayed his brethren to serve the Scourge as the Lich King spread corruption through Lordaeron, then rose to command the Rot Hide gnolls from Fenris Isle.

faq.q: Why does Bethor Iceshard know Thule's magic?
faq.answer: Bethor and Thule were colleagues and fellow spellcasters before Lordaeron fell. Their studies together left Bethor intimately familiar with Thule’s favored spells, magical theory, and hexes.

faq.q: What is Bethor's Scroll used for?
faq.answer: Bethor’s Scroll holds counter-incantations made to unravel Thule’s spells. Apothecary Renferrel uses them to brew a potion that shields Forsaken champions from Ravenclaw’s hexes.

faq.q: Why are the Rot Hide gnolls a threat in Silverpine?
faq.answer: Thule Ravenclaw uses Scourge necromancy to coordinate and empower the Rot Hide gnolls. From Fenris Isle, they mount organized attacks on Forsaken settlements and patrols across Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
aliases: where to turn in thule ravenclaw
faq.answer: The journey begins with Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity’s Magic Quarter and ends with Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: What happens after Renferrel receives the scroll?
faq.answer: After developing the counter-potion, Renferrel sends you to report to High Executor Hadrec before an all-out assault on Fenris Isle to eliminate Thule Ravenclaw and reclaim the island.

angles.text: The conflict between Bethor and Thule reveals the divide among Lordaeron’s former magi. Some fell to necromancy, while others kept their arcane discipline through undeath.
For the Forsaken, stopping Thule Ravenclaw matters because his hold on Fenris Isle threatens the Sepulcher and the western approaches to the Capital City.
Driving Scourge remnants from Lordaeron helps secure the Horde’s only foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms.
